#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Static file server for local testing of the built editor/player bundles.

Serves ./website (or the first CLI arg) with caching disabled so a rebuilt
beepbox_editor.min.js is always picked up on refresh.

Usage: python3 tools/serve.py [dir] [port]
"""
import http.server
import os
import socketserver
import sys

DIRECTORY = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "website"
PORT = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8080"))


class NoCacheHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate")
        self.send_header("Pragma", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("Expires", "0")
        super().end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):  # quiet
        pass


class Server(socketserver.TCPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.chdir(DIRECTORY)
    with Server(("", PORT), NoCacheHandler) as httpd:
        print(f"serving {os.getcwd()} on http://localhost:{PORT}")
        print("  editor:  http://localhost:%d/" % PORT)
        print("  debug:   http://localhost:%d/index_debug.html" % PORT)
        print("  player:  http://localhost:%d/player/" % PORT)
        print("ctrl-c to stop")
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\nstopped")

# UltraBox — local build/test helpers.
# Run `make` for the target list. Nothing here deploys or publishes.

PORT ?= 8080
NPX  ?= npx
SRC  := editor synth player global
STAMP := .build-stamp

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help
.PHONY: help check editor player synth all dev serve watch debug offline offline-html clean distclean stamp

help:
	@echo "make dev        - build editor bundle, then serve website/ on :$(PORT)"
	@echo "make editor     - build website/beepbox_editor[.min].js only (usual test loop)"
	@echo "make watch      - rebuild editor on every .ts change (ctrl-c to stop)"
	@echo "make check      - type-check editor, player, synth without emitting (fast)"
	@echo "make serve      - serve website/ with cache disabled"
	@echo "make debug      - build editor, then swap unminified bundle in as .min.js"
	@echo "make player     - build player bundle"
	@echo "make synth      - build standalone synth bundle"
	@echo "make all        - synth + player + editor (= npm run build)"
	@echo "make offline    - build electron/offline bundle into to_deploy/"
	@echo "make clean      - remove build/ and to_deploy/"
	@echo "make distclean  - also remove generated website/beepbox*.js(.map)"

# Type checking only. Catches errors before the bundle step.
check:
	$(NPX) tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
	$(NPX) tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig_player.json
	$(NPX) tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig_synth_only.json

editor:
	bash ./compile_beepbox_editor.sh
	@touch $(STAMP)

player:
	bash ./compile_beepbox_player.sh

synth:
	bash ./compile_beepbox_synth.sh

all: synth player editor

# Main test flow: rebuild, serve, open the URL printed.
dev: editor serve

serve:
	python3 ./tools/serve.py website $(PORT)

# Poll loop (no entr/fswatch dependency). Plain reload in browser after each rebuild.
watch:
	@touch $(STAMP)
	@echo "watching $(SRC)/*.ts for changes (ctrl-c to stop)"
	@while true; do \
		changed=$$(find $(SRC) -name '*.ts' -newer $(STAMP) | head -1); \
		if [ -n "$$changed" ]; then \
			echo "--> $$changed"; \
			$(MAKE) --no-print-directory editor || echo "!! build failed, keeping old bundle"; \
		fi; \
		sleep 1; \
	done

# Unminified bundle under the .min.js name that index.html loads. Debuggable stack traces.
debug: editor
	bash ./debugify.sh

offline:
	bash ./compile_beepbox_offline.sh

offline-html:
	bash ./compile_beepbox_offline_html.sh

clean:
	rm -rf build to_deploy $(STAMP)

# Generated bundles are gitignored, so removing them is safe but slow to rebuild.
distclean: clean
	rm -f website/beepbox*.js website/beepbox*.js.map website/player/beepbox*.js*

**Targets**
```

make editor   website/beepbox_editor[.min].js only (usual test loop)
make watch    poll-loop rebuild on .ts change (no entr/fswatch needed)
```

Was hardcoded. `editor/style.ts:1341` → `border-top: 11px solid #ffaa00;`. Now:

```css
.beepboxEditor .channelBox.hasComment::after {
	border-top: 11px solid var(--comment-marker);

```

New theme variable `--comment-marker`:
- `ColorConfig.setTheme` injection (line 6289): `--comment-marker: var(--link-accent,#74f)` when a theme doesn't define one → every existing theme (dark, light, custom, player) inherits its own accent, zero fixed hex in CSS.
- `"cod"` overrides: `--comment-marker: var(--mute-button-normal)` → ochre `#c9902f` on the sand canvas. Chained to the theme value, not a literal, so if you retune mutes the triangle follows.

Fallback is prepended to the theme stylesheet (`valuesToAdd + textContent`), same mechanism as the other vars — player path also covered since `player/main.ts` calls `setTheme`.
